visual.description: A man's hand clicking a silver stopwatch in an extreme close-up.

vo.en: Quick. Two plus two? Four plus four? Eight plus eight? Sixteen plus sixteen?

visual.description: Rapidly scrolling digital numbers and math equations on a dark screen.

vo.en: Stop. Now, shout out the first vegetable that pops into your head!

visual.description: An abstract visualization of a human brain glowing with electric blue neural pathways.

vo.en: Wait, the creepy part is I already knew exactly what you'd choose.

visual.description: A mysterious man in a dark hoodie looking directly into the camera lens.

vo.en: It’s a glitch called heuristic priming. Your brain, overwhelmed by math, defaults to the most common prototype.

visual.description: Golden mechanical clock gears rotating and intermeshing with precision.

vo.en: You thought of a carrot. Am I right? Your mind took the path of least resistance.

visual.description: A close-up shot of several bright orange carrots being pulled from dark garden soil.

vo.en: Subscribe for tomorrow’s brain test and comment YES if I got you. I knew it because you...

visual.description: A person's thumb tapping and scrolling quickly on a bright smartphone screen.
